description: <p>IT may have taken seven months, but incarcerated former prime minister Imran Khan has <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2041650">finally met his lawyer</a>.</p> <p>Meetings between prisoners and their counsel are a right, but the unfortunate fact is that when it comes to the PTI chief, legal requirements have mostly been ignored.</p> <p>The PTI says that Barrister Salman Safdar only discussed legal issues with the former prime minister, and that political matters were not brought up in the brief meeting.
